Doctoral Degrees
San Diego State University only offers doctoral degrees at the San Diego campus.
How to Apply
Apply to the university through Cal State Apply.
Submit required documents to Graduate Admissions.
Submit department required materials. Please review individual program requirements for more details.
Consult joint campus requirements if applying to a joint doctoral program.
Review more detailed instructions on how to apply on the Graduate Students web page. If you are a graduate applicant who will study in the U.S. on an F-1 Visa, review the International Graduate Students web page.
